newsitem.title: USA: Duke says tests needed at N.C. power plant.
newsitem.headline: Duke says tests needed at N.C. power plant.

text.p: Duke Power Co will conduct tests on the steam generator at its McGuire nuclear power plant, unit 2, slightly delaying its return to full power, the company said Wednesday.
"We expect it to return to full power over the next couple of days," said company spokesman Rick Zuercher.
The company earlier Wednesday said the unit likely would reach its full 1,129 megawatt (MW) capacity later today.
The unit would continue to operate at about 98 percent of capacity through the generator testing, the spokesman said.
The facility was shut Oct 31 after its backup batteries failed a routine performance test.
